description: Tasks whose field values contain characters that can break a selector, a JSON round-trip, a text node, or a rendered string if the app mishandles them. The characters are: quotes (single and double), backslashes, forward slashes, ampersands, angle brackets, backticks, newlines, carriage returns, tabs, and the Unicode line/paragraph separators. Every task here is valid; the fixture is the input to a round-trip and rendering test, not a rejection test.
